description: The settled centre: voices, work, animals. The sound of being where other people are.
Open ground north of the town, where the grain is.
The wood, and any open wilderness that is not farm or mine.
Worked stone, still under the sky.
Under the ground. Every floor of the dungeon and the crypt.
Indoors: the tavern, and any roof the cast can get under.
Plays over the login and character-creation screens; stops on entering the world.
A weapon going through the air. Played for a blow you can see.
A staff-wielder's bolt, released with the cast rather than on impact.
Taking a blow. Five takes, so a long fight does not become a loop.
Taking a blow. One file of several takes, separated at load.
Falling. Nineteen takes in one file, separated at load.
A wound closed by someone else's hands (D-205). Plays on a successful treat.
The one sanctioned crossing (D-204): a seance opening, or a corpse standing up.
PLANNED: there is no ranged weapon yet. Authored so the file has a home, and deliberately unwired rather than attached to a melee swing.
